releases.body:
Fix Markdown heading styles.

- Register `markup.heading.1` through `.6` in the SyntaxStyle. OpenTUI resolves dotted scopes only to the first segment, so H1 and H4-H6 previously fell back to the unregistered `markup` scope.
- Includes the v0.3.0 self-update command and the v0.2.1 SyntaxStyle lifecycle fix.
- README screenshots for the Markdown and Python previews are on main (docs/screenshots).

Install:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-file-browser
```

Documentation release: the npm package is now the recommended install.

- `opencode plugin add opencode-file-browser`
- update with `opencode plugin update opencode-file-browser`
- clone install remains available for offline/edge cases
- includes the v0.3.0 self-update command and the v0.2.1 SyntaxStyle fix

TUI-only plugin for OpenCode V2.

Adds a self-update command.

- Run `/files-update` (or the palette command **Update file browser**) to pull the latest checkout and let the TUI reload it.
- Includes the v0.2.1 fix for `NativeSyntaxStyle is destroyed`.
- TUI-only plugin for OpenCode V2.

Install:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/arthurrogado/opencode-file-browser ~/.config/opencode/plugins/file-browser
```

Fixes a crash when opening Markdown or code after the first render.

- Keep the OpenTUI `SyntaxStyle` alive for the component lifetime; it is now destroyed only on cleanup. Previously `renderer.idle()` resolved after the next frame and destroyed the style while the viewer was still using it (`Could not render this file: NativeSyntaxStyle is destroyed`).
- Rename the build script to `bundle` to avoid npm Git-dependency preparation on install.
- `dist/tui.js` is prebuilt; nothing compiles on install.

Install:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/arthurrogado/opencode-file-browser ~/.config/opencode/plugins/file-browser
```

Superseded by **v0.2.1**, which fixes a crash when opening Markdown or code after the first render (`NativeSyntaxStyle is destroyed`). Use v0.2.1.

- Browse folders in a session side panel or as a full-page route.
- Preview Markdown rendered; press m to switch to the source.
- Read code with tree-sitter highlighting.
- Open any file by path (`o` in the browser, or `Ctrl+X` then `O` globally).
- Toggle full screen with `f` to hide the chat.
- TUI-only plugin for OpenCode V2.

Install:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/arthurrogado/opencode-file-browser ~/.config/opencode/plugins/file-browser
```
